title: Overnight Bircher Muesli with Grated Apple, Pecans and Raspberries
summary: Rolled oats soak overnight in milk and yoghurt with grated apple, pecans and dried fruit, then are topped with raspberries and apple slices.
equipment: large bowl or lidded container (about 1.5 litres)

ingredients.item: whole milk, plus a little more to loosen
medium apples, grated on the large holes with skin
small apple, thinly sliced, to serve

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Stir the oats, milk, yoghurt, grated apple with its juice, pecans, raisins and cranberries together in the bowl. Grating the apple with its skin adds fibre, and its juice sweetens the mixture.

steps.title: Soak
steps.text: Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour, ideally overnight, until the oats are soft and creamy.

steps.title: Loosen
steps.text: Stir well and add a splash of milk if it has become too thick.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon into 4 bowls and top with the raspberries and apple slices.

tips: Using instant oats is the commonest mistake; they turn to mush, while rolled oats stay pleasantly chewy.
Grate the apple just before mixing so it doesn't brown.
Add the fresh toppings only when serving.
Sweeten with a little honey at the table if you like.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 3 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
